summary: Столп 4 P0 (движок, upstream-фикс, разблокирует T-0638): choros.job.instance_id/process_def_id (миграция 111, T-0534) пишутся в БД корректно при enqueue агентского job (externalTaskBridge.ts передаёт Flowable ExternalTask engine-метаданные — processInstanceId/processDefinitionKey, НЕ бизнес-переменные — как позиционные аргументы pgJobStore.enqueue()), но нигде не читались обратно. Четыре независимых разрыва одной цепочки: (1) src/core/types.ts's Job-интерфейс не имел полей instanceId/processDefId вообще; (2) src/core/postgres/pgJobStore.ts's fetchAndLock() RETURNING-список и rowToJob() их не выбирали/не мапили; (3) src/server/agent-dispatch-loop.ts's PostgresAgentJobFetcher — ОТДЕЛЬНАЯ ручная копия той же CTE, РЕАЛЬНЫЙ production-путь живого агентского диспетчера (wired в main.ts, НЕ через PostgresJobStore.fetchAndLock) — имел ТУ ЖЕ дыру в своём собственном RETURNING; (4) src/runtime/agent-dispatch/agent-step-context.ts::readJobVars() читал instanceId/procKey ИСКЛЮЧИТЕЛЬНО из job.variables (BPMN business-переменные шага), которые никогда не несут реальный instanceId (это engine-метаданные, не process-переменная) — поэтому каждый живой agentTask давал ctx.instanceId="". Итог, вскрытый LIVE_PROOF T-0638 (репро на стенде, инстанс 99573238): T-0638's фикс defer-resolve технически корректен, но был ИНЕРТЕН — пустая строка трактуется deferred-inbox-store.ts как null → человек, завершающий взятую defer-карточку, получал 404 DEFER_NOT_ROUTABLE; инстанс висел, хотя движок токен давно продвинул. ФИКС: протянуты обе DB-колонки (уже существующие с миграции 111 — 0 новых миграций) через все 4 звена — типы → оба SELECT/RETURNING-пути (pgJobStore.ts И agent-dispatch-loop.ts's отдельная CTE-копия) → readJobVars() теперь предпочитает job.instanceId/processDefId над variables-fallback (variables остаётся fallback для легаси jobs). Аддитивно и обратно совместимо: InMemoryJobStore не менялся (не нуждается — optional-поля не ломают его объектные литералы), legacy/NULL-колонки → null, не крашится.

mechanism.root_cause: Migration 111 (T-0534, tel-intake DMN triage seam) added choros.job.process_def_id/instance_id specifically so the triage seam could scope rule-table lookups by process WITHOUT relying on process variables (migration docstring's own stated intent). externalTaskBridge.ts's runBridgeOnce already passes task.processDefinitionKey/task.processInstanceId (real Flowable ExternalTask wire-shape fields, src/core/flowable-client.ts) into pgJobStore.enqueue()'s 5th/6th positional params, which correctly INSERTs them. But no code downstream ever selected them back: pgJobStore.ts's JobRow interface/rowToJob()/fetchAndLock() RETURNING clause omitted the columns entirely (confirmed by reading the file — RETURNING listed only id/topic/variables/state/retries/lock_owner/lock_expiry/created_at/available_at); src/core/types.ts's Job interface had no processDefId/instanceId fields at all. Separately AND MORE CRITICALLY, the actual live agent-dispatch loop (main.ts wires startAgentDispatchLoop, which constructs PostgresAgentJobFetcher, src/server/agent-dispatch-loop.ts:545) does NOT call PostgresJobStore.fetchAndLock at all — it has its OWN hand-rolled fetchAndLock-equivalent CTE (necessitated by the migrator/BYPASSRLS cross-tenant discovery logic PostgresJobStore.fetchAndLock doesn't implement), with an independently-authored RETURNING list that had the identical omission. Downstream, agent-step-context.ts's readJobVars() read instanceId/procKey ONLY from job.variables via candidate-key probing (str("instanceId")||str("processInstanceId")||str("inst")) — but job.variables holds BPMN business variables (task.variables from the Flowable external task), and no code anywhere stamps a variables.instanceId/processInstanceId entry for a live agent-step job (externalTaskBridge.ts's resolveInstanceId/resolveAuthoredProcessKey helpers read the SAME candidate keys but are a best-effort audit-correlation path for a DIFFERENT topic, not a producer for agent-step). Result: every freshly-dispatched agentTask job produced ctx.instanceId==='' — exactly the symptom T-0638's live-proof captured (repro instance 99573238, stand http://100.121.76.86:3000).
mechanism.fix_chosen: Threaded the ALREADY-CORRECT enqueue-time values through the four broken read points rather than inventing a new correlation mechanism or stamping BPMN process variables (the rejected alternative — see ADR §4): (1) src/core/types.ts — Job gains `processDefId?: string | null` and `instanceId?: string | null`, both OPTIONAL so every existing Job-literal construction site (InMemoryJobStore.enqueue's explicit object literal, every test's makeJob() helper) keeps compiling unmodified — TypeScript allows omitting optional fields. (2) src/core/postgres/pgJobStore.ts — JobRow gains matching optional snake_case fields; rowToJob() maps them with a `?? null` normalization (undefined/absent column → null, never a crash); EVERY SELECT/RETURNING list in the file (both enqueue paths — the plain-insert RETURNING and the idempotent-conflict insert+select-back RETURNING — plus getById, listByTopic, listByState, listByTopicAndState, and the critical fetchAndLock) now explicitly lists process_def_id, instance_id. (3) src/server/agent-dispatch-loop.ts — PostgresAgentJobFetcher's own inlined CTE gets the identical treatment: RETURNING gains j.process_def_id, j.instance_id; the inline TS row-type gains matching fields; the jobRows.map(...) construction stamps processDefId/instanceId from the row (`?? null`), mirroring the exact pattern already used for __tenantId (authoritative row value, never the loop iterator). (4) src/runtime/agent-dispatch/agent-step-context.ts::readJobVars() now checks job.instanceId/job.processDefId FIRST (trimmed, non-empty check) and falls back to the pre-existing variables-candidate-key probe only when the column is absent/null/empty — preserving the existing fallback behavior for legacy jobs (enqueued before migration 111, or via a caller that never captured process scope) and for every existing unit-test fixture that places instanceId inside variables (agent-dispatch-loop.test.ts's makeJob()).
mechanism.not_weakening: No migration added (columns already exist since 111 — this is a pure code-thread, zero DDL). No frozen ci/checks/*.sh file touched (frozen-checks-immutable.sh verified green). anti-case-lock.sh/detel-literal-baseline.sh stay at their exact pre-existing baseline (this diff adds zero new case-denylisted literal occurrences — new test fixtures use telLinear/procA/procB/generic ids already excluded by the test-file exclusion rule, verified by re-running anti-case-lock.sh --self-test). flowable-bridge-contract.sh and agent-bridge-contract.sh (T-0028/T-0636 static invariants on the bridge/dispatch files this diff touches) both verified green post-fix. ACCEPTED DECISION 1 (dispatch-outcome.ts's defer-always-closes-the-agent's-own-external-task semantics) is completely untouched — this task only fixes what ctx.instanceId CONTAINS, not when/how the agent step closes.
mechanism.side_effects_checked: InMemoryJobStore (src/core/inMemoryJobStore.ts) was audited line-by-line: its enqueue() has a 3-parameter signature (topic, variables, retries, idempotencyKey?) that does NOT accept processDefId/instanceId at all (T-0534's positional-args extension only exists on PostgresJobStore.enqueue, a 7-parameter method) — jobs it produces simply lack these optional Job fields, and readJobVars() falls through to the (unchanged) variables-based fallback for them, exactly as before this fix. No other Job-literal construction site in src/ was found (grepped for `: Job = ` and `as Job` — only src/core/inMemoryJobStore.ts and a single non-full-object type-cast in agent-dispatch-loop.ts, both verified safe). Enqueue's own RETURNING lists (both plain and idempotent-conflict paths) were ALSO updated for completeness/consistency even though no current caller reads the returned Job's instanceId/processDefId (externalTaskBridge.ts's two enqueue() call sites only use the return value to increment result.enqueued) — closing this second silent gap pre-emptively rather than leaving an asymmetric SELECT-list surface.

chain_threaded: enqueue (src/core/externalTaskBridge.ts, unchanged — already wrote process_def_id/instance_id correctly to the DB via pgJobStore.enqueue()'s positional 5th/6th args, sourced from Flowable ExternalTask.processDefinitionKey/processInstanceId) → choros.job DB columns (migration 111, unchanged, already correct) → src/core/postgres/pgJobStore.ts's fetchAndLock/enqueue/getById/listBy* RETURNING+SELECT lists (FIXED: now select process_def_id, instance_id) → rowToJob() (FIXED: maps them onto Job.processDefId/instanceId with ?? null) → src/server/agent-dispatch-loop.ts's PostgresAgentJobFetcher.fetchAndLockAgentJobs — the REAL production path (FIXED: its own independent RETURNING clause + row-type + jobRows.map() mapping, mirroring the __tenantId stamping pattern) → src/runtime/agent-dispatch/agent-step-context.ts::readJobVars() (FIXED: now prefers job.instanceId/job.processDefId over the variables-candidate-key fallback) → assembleAgentStepContext's AgentStepContext.instanceId/procKey (unchanged, now receives a real value) → dispatch-outcome.ts's deferredAuditEvent's payload.instance_id (unchanged) → deferred-inbox-store.ts's DeferredInboxRow.instanceId (unchanged, T-0638) → POST /api/inbox/:id/action's resolve-by-instance engine-drive (unchanged, T-0638) — the whole downstream mechanism T-0638 built is now fed a real value instead of "".
in_memory_jobstore: src/core/inMemoryJobStore.ts audited, NOT modified, and NOT broken. Its enqueue() is a 3-parameter method (no processDefId/instanceId params — that extension only exists on PostgresJobStore.enqueue's 7-parameter signature, T-0534/T-0636). Job objects it constructs use an explicit object literal (not spread); adding two OPTIONAL fields to the Job interface does not require this literal to populate them (TypeScript optional-field semantics). readJobVars() for in-memory-driven jobs (unit tests, no-Postgres dev fallback) falls through cleanly to the pre-existing variables-based lookup, unchanged behavior.

friction_events: This task required auditing TWO independent RETURNING/SELECT implementations of the same fetchAndLock CTE logic (PostgresJobStore.fetchAndLock in src/core/postgres/pgJobStore.ts, and PostgresAgentJobFetcher.fetchAndLockAgentJobs's own inlined CTE in src/server/agent-dispatch-loop.ts) — the T-0638 handoff's follow_up_needed note only explicitly named 'pgJobStore.ts's fetchAndLock', which would NOT have fixed the actual production dispatch path (main.ts wires PostgresAgentJobFetcher, which never calls PostgresJobStore.fetchAndLock at all). Verified this by tracing main.ts → startAgentDispatchLoop → buildAgentDispatchDeps/PostgresAgentJobFetcher construction (line 545) before concluding both call sites needed the identical fix — fixing only the named one would have left T-0638 still inert on a real stand.
